---
about:
  template: trestles
  image: images/passport.png
  links:
    - icon: github
      href: https://github.com/prashantnag
    - icon: envelope
      href: mailto:prashantnag.workmail@gmail.com
    - icon: linkedin
      href: https://www.linkedin.com/in/prashantnag/
    - icon: twitter
      href: https://twitter.com/nagprashant
    - icon: youtube
      href: https://www.youtube.com/@ResearchInfuser
comments: false
toc: false

listing:
  - id: recent-publications
    contents:
      - publications/
    exclude:
      exclude-from-recent: true
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    template: html/home/updates.ejs
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false

  - id: recent-talks
    contents:
      - talks/*.yml
    exclude:
      exclude-from-recent: true
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    template: html/home/updates.ejs
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false

  - id: recent-blog-posts
    contents:
      - ResearchInfuser/
    exclude:
      exclude-from-recent: true
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    template: html/home/updates.ejs
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false

  - id: recent-news
    contents: news.yml
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    template: html/home/news-updates.ejs
    field-types:
      date: date
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---
